'''Darth Vader's boot polisher''' was a young [[Human/Legends|man]] who aided [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] in the [[Belderone sector/Legends|Belderone sector]]. During a briefing with several of the [[Officer/Legends|officers]] that ruled over the [[Sector/Legends|sector]], this man hovered around Vader's boots, attempting to polish them, even as the Dark Lord gestured wildly to his men. During a second meeting with the officers, the boot polisher was tasked with filling up drinks for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]]. It was here that he witnessed the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Andrid]] at Vader's hands.
